fix: handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts instead of panicking

Pressing Ctrl+D (EOF) during an interactive prompt previously caused either
a panic from an unwrap on the IO error path or an infinite loop in custom
prompts that silently ignored the control character. This adds a dedicated
PromptAborted error variant and converts EOF/terminal-unavailable conditions
to it, giving callers a clean signal that the user cancelled input.
EOF
